description: This file contains validation functions for different schema components and messages in the A2UI protocol, including validation of surface updates, data model updates, rendering commands, and component properties.

methods.name: validateSchema
methods.description: Main function to validate various schema messages based on their properties and optional matchers.

methods.name: validateSurfaceUpdate
methods.description: Validates the surfaceUpdate message structure, including component IDs and properties.

methods.name: validateDataModelUpdate
methods.description: Validates the dataModelUpdate message, including contents and key-value properties.

methods.name: validateBoundValue
methods.description: Validates bound value properties within components, ensuring correct object structure and key usage.

methods.name: validateComponent
methods.description: Validates individual UI components, their required properties, references, and specific constraints based on component type.
